name: pyth_mock
description:
Pyth PriceAccount mock — byte layout compatible with pyth-sdk-solana's load_price_feed_from_account_info aggregate-price read path. Total size 3312 bytes (#[repr(C)], 8-byte aligned). Only the aggregate-price subset is populated; SMA (ema_price/ema_conf), multi-publisher comp[] array, prod/next account refs, and per-publisher metadata remain zero-filled (follow-up).

Layout mirrors pyth-sdk-solana::GenericPriceAccount<32, ()>. When the layout drifts upstream, update engine/src/scenario/oracle.rs::PythMockOracleLayout in lock-step with this IDL and the pyth_real_layout test's MockPriceAccountPrefix mirror struct.

accounts.name: priceAccount
accounts.description: Pyth `PriceAccount` aggregate-price layout. Fixed fields at their byte offsets — this IDL lists them in declaration order. All integers little-endian, #[repr(C)] padding preserved. Use this as the reference when authoring adapters that declare `[[oracles]] kind = "pyth"`.

fields.name: expo
fields.description: Price exponent (negative to report sub-integer prices)

fields.name: ema_price_val
fields.description: Stable mirror of agg.price for readers that fall back to EMA.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Zero-filled; a future drop may populate from engine slot clock.

fields.name: agg_price
fields.description: Aggregate price. This is what load_price_feed_from_account_info returns as PriceFeed.price when agg_status == Trading.

fields.name: agg_status
fields.value: 1 (Trading, so readers don't fall through to prev_*)
